content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"review","note":"The final decision's conclusion (no preponderant evidence of protected-class motivation) is stated, but the record does not trace how the evidence led to it, and it omits any weighing of the conflicting accounts on claims 2-5, 7 and 9 or any comparator evidence."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Most characterizations are attributed to named roles (HR Supervisor, HR Officer, RA Coordinator, EEO Specialist), but the Complainant's own testimony is summarized without a source, there are no witness statements on the alleged remarks or the shouting, and the doctor's reports date from 2005 with no author or document identified."},"rc3":{"status":"gap","note":"Claims 1-7 are alleged only 'on unspecified dates' and the accommodation request date is never fixed, so the sequence cannot be followed; only training (Sept-Nov 2019), the Feb 25 and Mar 19, 2020 meetings and the May 20-21, 2020 termination are dated."},"rc4":{"status":"review","note":"The HR Officer's May 20, 2020 letter identifies the recommending supervisor and the stated reason, but the record gives no performance criteria or threshold, no evidence that Complainant's response was considered before termination, and no reasoning in the final decision showing how the evidence was weighed."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Undated allegations, an unresolved conflict on whether an accommodation request was made, 2005 medical records unconnected to the 2019-2020 period, and no analysis linking evidence to the finding mean an independent reviewer could not assess support for the decision without outside context."}}}
